yang diperihalkan dalam Jadual Kedua.

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY ACT 2006

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY (RATES FOR WATER SUPPLY SERVICES)

(STATE OF PAHANG) REGULATIONS 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 84(2)(a) and 179(i) of the

Water Services Industry Act 2006 [Act 655], the Minister, on the recommendation

of the Commission, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Water Services Industry

(Rates for Water Supply Services) (State of Pahang) Regulations 2022.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 August 2022.

Rates for water supply services

2. The rates for water supply for the state of Pahang shall be as prescribed

in the First Schedule.

Type of use

3. The type of use as specified in the First Schedule shall be as described

in the Second Schedule.
